rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0026, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.005, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-19 DECAY intermediate at the peak config. iter-18 (500it) hr=0.35343 < iter-17 (1000it) 0.36293 -> 1000 iters genuinely needed. Decay was probed once (iter-11 decay 0.01->0.001 CRASHED hr->0.16989, too-large late steps oscillate) but never at an intermediate value. ONE knob: tv_decay 0.01->0.005 (mild; step at iter1000 = 0.01/6 ~= 0.00167 vs 0.0009 at decay=0.01 and 0.005 at decay=0.001). Keep lambda=2.6e-3, 1000it, lr=0.01, gd, fbp. HYPOTHESIS: a mildly larger late step converges TV slightly further without the oscillation that decay=0.001 caused, so hr edges past 0.36293; if it still over-steps (hr drops) decay=0.01 is the firm optimal schedule. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
